title: Zesty Greek Renkon Lotus Root Souvlaki
description: A nostalgic Greek dish featuring renkon lotus root, binchotan charcoal, and ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients, served in a mason jar as a souvlaki.

ingredients.name: renkon lotus root
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1/2 inch thick rounds

instructions: Preheat the binchotan charcoal grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Add the sliced renkon lotus root to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lotus root slices onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the souvlaki for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lotus root is tender and lightly charred.
Serve the souvlaki in a mason jar, garnished with a sprinkle of oregano and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Let the souvlaki rest for 5 minutes before serving.
